replies.author: @tanyawales5445
replies.text:
Currently, there are no operational data centers located in or directly adjacent to Mammoth Cave, KY.

However, there are highly contested ongoing proposals and developments in the surrounding region:
Cave City, KY: Developers (such as Discovery) have eyed Cave City—the gateway to Mammoth Cave National Park—for large-scale data facilities. In response to heavy community opposition, the Cave City City Council passed a one-year moratorium to halt data center development while they evaluate zoning rules. <========

Simpson County, KY: A preliminary development plan for a data center was approved by the Franklin-Simpson Planning and Zoning Commission. However, the project is tied up in ongoing lawsuits between developers, the county, and local citizens groups.

Warren County, KY: The Warren County Planning and Zoning Commission amended its regulations to open the door for potential data center construction, though no specific centers have broken ground near the park.

Local governments are actively evaluating how these large industrial projects align with the tourism and environmental safety of the Mammoth Cave region. You can follow local development updates via the Bowling Green Daily News or check Cave City Municipal Information for official public notices regarding zoning changes.
